title: More pre-registered claim tests
headline: 8 new pre-registered tests of proved math-bio laws are complete (3 supported, 1 refuted, 2 mixed, 2 blocked on Dryad downloads); 12 tests in all.
blockers: Dryad (datadryad.org) blocks scripted downloads with a proof-of-work challenge; two pre-registered tests (hamilton-lmc, maynardsmith-war-of-attrition) are inconclusive until someone downloads 3 small files in a browser into their data/ folders.

needs.ask: Download DryadData.xlsx (doi:10.5061/dryad.15nj0) and fight.csv + README.md (doi:10.5061/dryad.bg79cnpjg) in a browser into claim-tests/math-bio-theorems/hamilton-lmc/data/ and .../maynardsmith-war-of-attrition/data/, then tell me; fetch.py records the checksums and the pre-registered analysis runs unchanged.
Run `python analysis.py --exam` in kimura-heterozygosity and hamilton-senescence when the exam is due; bird rows are never fitted.
